about: A reply that is only [quiet] (spaces trimmed, any case) is hidden: index.js quietReply, client.js quietText, Tether quietReply. `turns`: the steps of one completed turn (each a list of blocks: a string is a text, "tool" a tool call, "think" reasoning); `quiet` is the run rule (index.js quietRun, client.js quietTurnSet) and `reply` the words of a turn that is news on the desktop (index.js runReply). `push` is the words of Damon's Turn finished notification of that completed turn, null for none (index.js damonPushWords, Tether damonWords, 2026-11-24): a turn whose last text starts or ends with [quiet] gives none, not even its first part; a turn that starts with [quiet] and ends with a real answer (a card) gives that answer (2026-11-27). `steered`: news turns with a prompt that came into the running turn (a string step, not a list: a message that you typed, or `@<source kind>` for a subagent's notice) and `push`, the words of Damon's notification: the part after your message answers you, so its newest text that does not start or end with [quiet] pushes; another part gives none when its last text starts or ends with [quiet] (while its newest message has a tool call, the turn's last text decides). A turn that you open by typing keeps the strict rule (test/tether-push-words.test.mjs). test/quiet-replies.test.mjs, the iOS QuietReplyTests and PushTextTests read this table. `hushed` (2026-11-27): a completed turn whose last text is only [quiet] shows a text sent with a tool call only after the turn's first Auto review denial, or when its first line starts bold (the result line of the reply form, 2026-11-27) (client.js hushedShown, client.js hushedRowKeys, Tether botLines and resultText; test/reply-cards.test.mjs, test/assistant-subagent-rows.test.mjs and the iOS QuietReplyTests read it): `denials` are the two result texts (the auto-review-agent-first plugin's and dsh's own); in `turns`, each step is [text, result] (result: null for no tool call, else "ok" or the index of a denial), and `shown` lists the texts that show. The last row ends with a real answer, not [quiet]: only that closing answer is a card and a Tether line (review 1: the phone showed the result line next to the tool call too, two cards with the same text); the Mac's chat rows of that turn are dsh's own (test/assistant-subagent-rows.test.mjs).
